errors: Gaussian CAR1 covariance residual_variance*rho^abs(actual_minute_difference); rho=0 means identity; independent subjects
synthetic_missingness: subjects with zero-based index divisible by five omit minutes 5 and 10; deterministic and independent of simulated outcomes; actual minute retained
generation: PCG64 seed SHA256(master|DGP_cell|replicate|generation); draw full trajectory then mask; do not clip Gaussian draws
paired_models: same synthetic dataset per replicate; no replacing failed fit
interpretation: 20 replicates/cell development diagnostic; not calibration, statistical power or mechanism proof for real data
